# Pinned Kotlin/Native license inventory

Unmodified license inventory from Kotlin/Native 2.4.21 used to build the bundled GS1Native framework. LICENSE.txt, NOTICE.txt and COPYRIGHT.txt are retained. The third_party directory records the compiler distribution inventory; it is not a claim that every listed compiler component is linked into the iOS library.

A public GS1 binary release still needs a clean reproducible build, runtime-specific notice review, and removal of personal absolute paths. The GS1 algorithm and local adapter source remain under GPL-3.0 as described in ../../NOTICE.md.
